tagline.zh: 元素与背景完全同色,仅靠「一侧暗、对侧亮」的双阴影把界面从底色里挤出或压入——低对比软塑料质感,2020 年达峰后因可访问性迅速退潮。
tagline.en: Elements share the page background color exactly; a dual shadow (dark on one side, light on the other) extrudes or presses them into the surface — a low-contrast soft-plastic look that peaked in 2020 and receded over accessibility failures.

origin.zh: 术语为 neo + skeuomorphism 合成词,2019 年由 Jason Kelly 创造;Alexander Plyuto 在 Dribbble 的银行 App 拟物稿引爆传播,雏形见于 2019 年华为鸿蒙智慧屏界面;2020 年 11 月 macOS Big Sur 被认为带明显新拟物特征;2021 年因可访问性问题迅速退潮(调研 03§3)。
origin.en: The term (neo + skeuomorphism) was coined by Jason Kelly in 2019; Alexander Plyuto's Dribbble banking-app shots ignited the trend, with an earlier precursor on Huawei's 2019 Honor Vision UI; macOS Big Sur (Nov 2020) was read as strongly neumorphic; it receded quickly through 2021 over accessibility failures (research 03 §3).

effect.zh: 页面与元素共用的基准底色。默认 #e0e5ec 是社区经典值(superdesign.dev):新拟物的塑形完全依赖双阴影,底色一旦与元素不同色,风格即失效。demo 用 color-mix 由底色现算暗影(底色加深 15%:#e0e5ec→#bec3c9)。
effect.en: The base color shared by page and elements. Default #e0e5ec is the community classic (superdesign.dev): shaping relies entirely on the dual shadow, so any mismatch between element and background breaks the style. The demo derives the dark shadow via color-mix (base darkened 15%: #e0e5ec → #bec3c9).

effect.zh: 双阴影偏移量。默认 9px 取自经典凸起配方 9px 9px 18px #bec3c9, -9px -9px 18px #ffffff(superdesign.dev);经典压入配方用 6px。经验法则:blur≈2×offset。
effect.en: Dual-shadow offset. Default 9px comes from the classic raised recipe 9px 9px 18px #bec3c9, -9px -9px 18px #ffffff (superdesign.dev); the classic inset recipe uses 6px. Rule of thumb: blur ≈ 2× offset.

effect.zh: 阴影模糊半径。默认 18px 为经典凸起配方值(=2×9px 偏移);经典压入配方用 12px(superdesign.dev)。模糊过大软影发虚,过小则变成硬边浮雕。
effect.en: Shadow blur radius. Default 18px is the classic raised recipe value (= 2× the 9px offset); the classic inset recipe uses 12px (superdesign.dev). Too much blur turns the shadow mushy; too little becomes a hard emboss.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-mode)。raised=凸起:暗影在右下、亮影在左上;inset=压入:阴影翻入内侧。经典压入配方为 inset 6px 6px 12px(superdesign.dev),demo 沿用当前 offset/blur 内凹以便对比。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-mode). raised = extruded: dark shadow bottom-right, light top-left; inset = pressed: shadows flip inside. The classic inset recipe is inset 6px 6px 12px (superdesign.dev); the demo insets with the current offset/blur for direct comparison.

note.zh: box-shadow 全平台可用;demo 用 color-mix() 由底色现算暗影(Chrome 111+/Edge 111+/Firefox 113+/Safari 16.2+),旧浏览器可直接写死经典色对 #bec3c9/#ffffff。
note.en: box-shadow works everywhere; the demo derives the dark shadow via color-mix() (Chrome 111+/Edge 111+/Firefox 113+/Safari 16.2+). Older browsers can hardcode the classic color pair #bec3c9/#ffffff.

fallback.zh: 双阴影无法传达层级时的退化方案:回到常规浅色卡片——保留同色底,补 1px 实色边框与常规投影区分边界,文本改用高对比墨色;交互态(按下/焦点)必须改用边框、填充或下划线等非阴影线索表达。
fallback.en: Degradation when dual shadows cannot carry hierarchy: fall back to an ordinary light card — keep the shared base, add a 1px solid border and a regular shadow to mark edges, switch text to a high-contrast ink; express pressed/focus states with non-shadow cues (border, fill, underline).

use.zh: 音乐播放器、计算器等「软塑料」控制面板(该风格最初的流行场景)
use.en: Soft-plastic control panels: music players, calculators — the style's original home

use.zh: 开关、滑杆、按钮组等低频控件,按压态凸起⇄压入语义清晰
use.en: Low-frequency controls (toggles, sliders, button groups) where raised⇄inset reads as press semantics

use.zh: 氛围优先的品牌页与概念稿,数据密度低、装饰性优先
use.en: Atmosphere-first brand pages and concept work: low data density, decoration over information

avoid.zh: 正文文本与关键信息——典型边缘对比仅约 1.4:1,低于 WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 的 3:1(调研 03§3 反例)
avoid.en: Body text and critical information — typical edge contrast is only ≈1.4:1, below the 3:1 of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 (research 03 §3 counter-example)

avoid.zh: 数据密集仪表盘与表单页——层级线索太弱,扫描成本高
avoid.en: Data-dense dashboards and forms — hierarchy cues are too weak to scan

avoid.zh: 暗色主题直接反色——暗色下需重调两个阴影而非简单反转(superdesign.dev)
avoid.en: Dark themes via simple color inversion — dark mode needs both shadows retuned, not flipped (superdesign.dev)

a11y.zh: 反例警示:典型新拟物元件的边缘对比仅约 1.4:1,无法满足 WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 组件边界 3:1 非文本对比,且在保留柔和质感的前提下不可修复——这正是其 2021 年退潮的核心原因。补救:文本一律用高对比墨色并独立核对 4.5:1;控件边界补 1px 实色描边或改回常规卡片;焦点态不得只靠阴影表达。
a11y.en: Counter-example warning: typical neumorphic edges measure only ≈1.4:1 contrast, failing the 3:1 non-text boundary requirement of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11, and the failure is unfixable while keeping the soft look — the core reason for its 2021 retreat. Mitigations: set text in high-contrast ink checked independently at 4.5:1; add a 1px solid edge or revert to regular cards for control boundaries; never encode focus state in shadows alone.

goal.zh: 用同色底双阴影复刻一块新拟物控制面板:凸起卡片、压入输入槽、可按压的软按钮,暗影=底色加深 15%,blur≈2×offset,并用 color-mix 从底色现算暗影色。
goal.en: Replicate a neumorphic control panel with same-color dual shadows: a raised card, an inset input well, pressable soft buttons; dark shadow = base darkened 15%, blur ≈ 2× offset, dark color derived from the base via color-mix.

acceptance.zh: 元素与背景必须完全同色,靠 box-shadow 双影塑形,不引入边框或渐变
acceptance.en: Elements share the background color exactly; shape via box-shadow dual shadows only, no borders or gradients

acceptance.zh: 凸起配方 9px 9px 18px 暗影 + -9px -9px 18px 亮影(亮影取纯白),压入翻成 inset
acceptance.en: Raised recipe: 9px 9px 18px dark + -9px -9px 18px light (light = pure white); inset flips to inset shadows

acceptance.zh: 暗影色=底色加深 15%(如 #e0e5ec→#bec3c9),亮影为纯白 #ffffff
acceptance.en: Dark shadow = base darkened 15% (e.g. #e0e5ec→#bec3c9); light shadow = pure white #ffffff

acceptance.zh: 模糊≈2×偏移;圆角落在 16–24px 区间
文本使用高对比墨色并核对 4.5:1;在 MDX 中保留 1.4:1 边缘对比反例警示
acceptance.en: Text uses high-contrast ink checked at 4.5:1; keep the ≈1.4:1 edge-contrast counter-example warning in the MDX
